documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: GNG Electronics reported its strongest quarterly and first-half performance for FY27, driven by 42% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2 and significant gross margin expansion. Management highlighted that elevated global memory prices and PC shortages act as near-term catalysts, effectively widening the absolute savings gap for customers choosing refurbished laptops. Consequently, the company raised its full-year FY27 guidance to 40% top-line growth and a 1.5% net margin improvement over the previous year. Management emphasized continuous investments in brand building under the Electronics Bazaar name, strategic inventory procurement, and expanding distribution networks globally. GNG Electronics Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational results in an investor presentation.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year FY27 top-line growth guidance to 40% over the previous financial year.
guidance.quote: On the top line for this financial year, we should grow by 40% over previous financial year.

guidance.claim: Management revised the PAT growth guidance to 1.5% from the previous guidance of 1%.
guidance.quote: And on the bottom line PAT point of view, it should be growing by 1.5% from previous guidance of 1%.

guidance.claim: Management revised the full-year revenue guidance from the earlier 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: In terms of specific guidance, we would like to revise our revenue guidance from earlier 25% to 30% and at the PAT level margin growth, we would like to increase it from 0.5% to 0.75% -1%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IDC projects a decline in global PC shipments of around 20% in the second half of calendar year 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: On our last earnings call on 30th July, I had shared IDC's projection of a decline of around 20% in global PC shipments in the second half of calendar year 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that IDC reported September quarter global PC shipments declined by 20.1% year-on-year to 62.7 million units.
demand_outlook.quote: IDC has since released its numbers for the September quarter, and the decline has come in at 20.1% year-on-year, which is 62.7 million units shipped as against 78.5 million shipped in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: The global ICT industry continues to witness a structural shift towards professionally refurbished computing solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: The global ICT industry continues to witness a structural shift towards professionally refurbished computing solutions, driven by rising prices of new devices, supply-side constraints in the global memory market, increasing focus on cost optimisation and sustainability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains confident in the long-term growth opportunity for the refurbished ICT industry driven by affordability, reliability and sustainability.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident in the long-term growth opportunity for the refurbished ICT industry. While rising memory prices and supply constraints provide a near-term catalyst, the underlying opportunity is driven by a structural shift towards affordability, reliability and sustainability.

demand_outlook.claim: IDC projects global PC shipments to decline by 11.3% for the full year 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: IDC now projects global PC shipments to decline 11.3% for full year 2026 with conditions expected to worsen in the second half, driving a 20% year-on-year decline in that period alone.

demand_outlook.claim: As new devices become increasingly unaffordable, consumers and enterprises are turning to refurbished devices.
demand_outlook.quote: As new devices become increasingly unaffordable, more and more consumers and enterprises are turning to Electronics Bazaar's premium refurbished devices with proven warranty.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that in UAE, facilities were expanded from 3 to 4 to almost 8 facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: In UAE also, we have enhanced from 3, 4 facilities to almost 8 facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that in India, space was almost doubled two to three quarters prior to the call.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have almost doubled our space almost 2, 3 quarters back.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced plans to expand the footprint in the Asia Pacific region by hiring talent in Singapore and Vietnam, increasing sales in Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and ASEAN countries.
capex_expansion.quote: We'll also now expand our footprint in Asia Pacific region with hiring of talent happening in Singapore, Vietnam. We'll increase our penetration and sales in Japan, Australia, New Zealand and all ASEAN countries.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue for the quarter ended September 2026 was INR624.8 crores, with gross margin improving by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1%.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter ended September 2026, our consolidated revenue stood at INR624.8 crores, which is up from INR439.9 crores in the same quarter last year. Gross margin improved by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1%.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of FY27, revenue stood at INR1,037 crores with gross margin expansion at 24.9%, an improvement of 438 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: Similarly, for the first half of FY27, revenue stood at INR1,037 crores, which is 38% up from the same period last year with gross margin expansion at 24.9%, which is an improvement of 438 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that advance inventory strategic decisions account for 125 to 150 basis points of the margin enhancement.
margins_costs.quote: Of this, it will be fair to assume that somewhere between 125 to 150 basis points is on account of the advanced inventory strategic decisions that have been taken.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that SK Hynix reported DRAM prices rose by high-twenties percentage and NAND by mid-20s percentage in a single quarter.
margins_costs.quote: SK Hynix, the world's second largest memory manufacturer, reported in its results on 28th of October 2026, that's just a few days ago, that DRAM prices rose by a high-twenties percentage in a single quarter and NAND by mid-20s percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 515 bps year-on-year to 25% in Q2 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Against this backdrop, we delivered a strong performance in Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 42% YoY to ₹625 crore, while gross margin expanded by 515 bps YoY to 25%.

margins_costs.claim: For H1 FY27, gross margin improved by 438 bps to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: For H1 FY27, revenue grew 38% YoY to ₹1,037 crore, with gross margin improving by 438 bps to 25%, reflecting the strength of our business model and continued execution momentum.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q2 FY27 stood at 15.0%.
Gross margin expanded by 329 basis points year-on-year and 542 basis points sequentially to 24.65%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded to 24.65%, improving by 329 basis points over last year and 542 basis points over the previous quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Memory prices have risen a further 5% to 10% in the last quarter alone.
margins_costs.quote: Memory prices have risen a further 5% to 10% in the last quarter alone.

margins_costs.claim: The price of an entry-level 8GB RAM and 512GB SSD laptop has risen from INR40,000 to INR48,000.
margins_costs.quote: Price of an entry-level 8GB RAM and 512GB SSD laptop has further risen from INR40,000 to INR48,000.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 12.8%, showing a year-on-year improvement of 156 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR52.8 crores, with EBITDA margin at 12.8%, an improvement of 156 basis points year-on-year compared to 11.3% in Q1 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that total volume processed in Q2 was about 225,000 units and for the first half was about 374,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: So in the quarter 2, we have had a total volume of about 2,25,000-odd units. And for the first half, the number is about 3,74,000-odd units.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that laptops constitute between 78% to 80% of volume proportions, with others making up the rest.
orders_capacity.quote: Broadly, this proportion between laptops and others continues to remain in the same trajectory of between 78% to 80% being laptops and others being the rest of it in terms of revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that customer touch points stand at 5,542, up from 5,130, and the supply base stands at 820, up from 773.
orders_capacity.quote: Customer touch points stand at 5,542, up from 5,130 and our supply base at 820, up from 773.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company supplies to 55 countries as of the end of Q2 FY27, up from 49 at the end of Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: As of the end of Q2 FY27, Electronics Bazaar supplies to 55 countries, up from 49 at the end of Q1.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its reach to 55 countries, increased customer touchpoints to 5,542 and grew its supplier base to 820.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we continued to strengthen our domestic and international presence, expanding our reach to 55 countries, increasing customer touchpoints to 5,542 and growing our supplier base to 820.

orders_capacity.claim: Electronics Bazaar supplies to 49 countries as of the end of Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: As of end of Q1 FY27, Electronics Bazaar supplies to 49 countries, up from 46 at the end of FY26.
Customer touchpoints have grown to 5,130 and our supplier base now stands at 773, reflecting deeper and more diversified sourcing across geographies.

capital_allocation.claim: Management reported the current net debt is about INR427 crores and anticipates a similar debt level for the full year.
capital_allocation.quote: As you would have seen the numbers, the current net debt is about INR427-odd crores. We anticipate that this level of debt, which was about INR406 crores at the end of previous quarter, right? So the current level of debt is something which we anticipate is a fair number to assume going forward as well.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that receivables generally range between 40 to 45 days.
capital_allocation.quote: And generally, the receivables are in the 40- to 45-day odd range, which is broadly in that direction.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt increased by about INR100 crores to INR406 crores at the end of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: This number was about INR399 crores or almost rounding off to INR400 crores at the end of March '26. This has gone to INR406 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Inventory at the end of Q1 stood at approximately INR700 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Yeah, the inventory at the end of Q1 is about INR700-odd crores. This has gone down, this has gone down from about INR740-odd crores at the end of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Michael Dell stated that he expects the memory shortage to get worse next year in terms of demand and supply and that it may well be a 4-year problem.
risks_headwinds.quote: Michael Dell, the founder of Dell Technologies, said in an interview with CNBC on 13th October that he expects the memory shortage to get worse next year in terms of demand and supply. And that in his own words, it may well be a 4-year problem because there's just not enough supply.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sanjay Mehrotra of Micron stated that Micron expects memory and storage supply conditions to be much tighter in fiscal year 2027 and 2028 than in 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sanjay Mehrotra, the Chief Executive of Micron, one of the 3 largest memory manufacturers in the world, said on its earnings call on 30th September 2026 that Micron expects memory and storage supply conditions to be and I quote "much tighter in fiscal year 2027 and 2028 than they were in 2026" and it does not have line of sight to when supply and demand will return to balance.

risks_headwinds.claim: SK Hynix CFO Kim Woo-hyun stated that memory supply cannot keep pace with demand and growth, projecting constraints through 2030.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Chief Financial Officer, Kim Woo-hyun, said and I quote "Memory supply cannot keep pace with this level of demand and growth" and described the shortfall as a constraint projected to continue through 2030.

risks_headwinds.claim: SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung stated that DRAM and HBM volumes for the next 3 years through 2029 are effectively sold out.
risks_headwinds.quote: Its Chief Executive, Kwak Noh-jung, said the company's DRAM and HBM volumes for the next 3 years through 2029 are effectively sold out.

risks_headwinds.claim: No meaningful relief for the persistent memory shortage is expected before the end of 2027.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary driver remains the persistent memory shortage for which no meaningful relief is expected before end of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management guided that the top line for this financial year should grow by 40% over the previous financial year.
management_commitments.quote: On the top line for this financial year, we should grow by 40% over previous financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management guided that PAT growth should be 1.5% from the previous guidance of 1%.
management_commitments.quote: And on the bottom line PAT point of view, it should be growing by 1.5% from previous guidance of 1%.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects inventory to reach around 90 days of projected sale two years down the line when the situation reaches a new normal.
management_commitments.quote: See, 2 years down the line, obviously, we expect situation to reach a new normal, at which point in time, we should see an inventory of around 90 days odd of our projected sale.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates the tax rate for the full year to be between 14% to 16%.
management_commitments.quote: From a guidance perspective for the full year, it will be fair to assume in your stack that the tax rate should be relative to 10.6%, 11% last year, it will be fair to assume a number somewhere between 14% to 16% from an assessment perspective.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to stay close to customers, execute with discipline, and build capabilities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to stay close to our customers, execute with discipline, and build the capabilities that will make Electronics Bazaar the world's most trusted name in premium refurbished computing.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they remain focused on continuing to deliver profitable, sustainable growth.
management_commitments.quote: We are comfortably ahead of our full year FY27 guidance, and we remain focused on continuing to deliver profitable, sustainable growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
